# Noumi - AI Personal Assistant

> Autonomous AI Personal Assistant: Built to Actually Do the Work.

## About

Noumi is an AI personal assistant that works like a colleague — understanding context, managing tasks, and delivering results without constant prompting.

**Website:** https://noumi.ai
**Product Type:** AI Personal Assistant
**Target Users:** Product Managers, Solutions Engineers, Journalists, Content Creators, Knowledge Workers

## Core Features

### Persistent Memory
Noumi remembers your work context, preferences, and project history across sessions. It builds a continuous understanding of your goals and working style.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/features/persistent-memory

### Autonomous Execution
Noumi takes initiative to complete tasks end-to-end without constant prompting. It breaks down complex requests, executes steps, and delivers finished results.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/features/autonomous-execution

### Self-Evolving Skills
Noumi learns from your corrections and feedback, continuously improving its performance on your specific workflows and tasks.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/features/self-evolving-skills

## Use Cases

### Product Manager
PRD writing, feature planning, user research synthesis, roadmap documentation, stakeholder communication.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/use-cases/product-manager

### Solutions Engineer
Technical documentation, demo preparation, customer onboarding, proof-of-concept development, integration guides.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/use-cases/solutions-engineer

### Journalist
Interview transcription, article drafting, fact-checking, source management, editorial workflow automation.

**URL:** https://noumi.ai/use-cases/journalist

## Key Differentiators

Unlike traditional AI assistants that require detailed prompting for every task, Noumi:
- Works autonomously with minimal supervision
- Maintains long-term memory of your projects and preferences
- Learns and adapts to your specific workflows
- Delivers complete, production-ready outputs rather than suggestions
